info.title: Geospatial
info.summary: The API of the Geospatial extension for Directus.

servers.description: The Directus the extension runs in.

get.summary: What the extension can do in this environment
get.description: The versions of the API, the extension and Directus, and the capability matrix: the level of each operation in the database in use. Only admins see the database and its spatial extension. Anonymous requests are refused.

403.description: The request has no authenticated user (code FORBIDDEN).

503.description: The database did not answer, so the extension cannot tell what it can do (code GEOSPATIAL_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE). The route answers again as soon as the database is back.

get.summary: The items of a collection that a spatial operation selects
get.description: The format of /items of Directus, with the parameter geo for the spatial operation. The items come out of the query Directus builds of what the user can read, with the filter and the search of the request, so a user only ever receives the items /items would give them. The values come as /items gives them, converted by Directus: the geometry in GeoJSON, a concealed field hidden, and the booleans, the JSON, the CSV and the dates in their format.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: The collection, by its name in Directus.

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: The spatial operation, as JSON, the way Directus takes the filter.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The fields of each item, as in /items, separated by commas. Fields of a relation are refused for now. The geometry the operation reads is always read by its name, so a user who cannot read it gets the error of /items.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The sort of /items, by fields separated by commas, with a minus for descending. It orders by the values the user can read, and an item whose field a policy holds back sorts as an empty one. Fields of a relation are refused for now. Without it, the items come in the natural order of the operation.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many items, as in /items. Without it, the default page of Directus, the QUERY_LIMIT_DEFAULT. The items beyond the maximum come by the next pages.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many items to skip, in the order of the list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page, as in /items, starting at 1.

200.description: The items, in the natural order of the operation, the distance for the radius, or in the sort of the request, and then by the primary key.

400.description: The geo or the limit is off the contract, or the request carries a parameter the operation does not take yet (code INVALID_QUERY of Directus).

403.description: The user cannot read the collection, a field the request asks for or the geometry, or the collection is one of the system, as in /items (code FORBIDDEN). On Directus 12, an inactive collection, to a user who can read it (code COLLECTION_INACTIVE).

501.description: The operation does not run on the database in use, or does not measure the type of the geometry field there (code GEOSPATIAL_OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE), with the operation and the reason in the extensions of the error.

503.description: The internals of the running Directus are not the ones the extension expects, so its operations are off (code GEOSPATIAL_INTERNALS_UNSUPPORTED), or the database did not answer (code GEOSPATIAL_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE).

get.description: The contract of the API, as OpenAPI 3.1: the same document the types of the SDK and the validation of the input come from. Anonymous requests are refused, since it carries the version of the API.

403.description: The request has no authenticated user (code FORBIDDEN).

bearer.description: A Directus access token. The session cookie of the Studio also works.

spatial.description: Only for admins. Null when the database has no spatial extension.

operations.description: The level of each operation, by its id. Empty until the first operation exists.

Internals.description: Only for admins. Whether the internals of the running Directus, which the operations build the permitted query with, are the ones an adapter of the extension expects, as the check found them when the extension started. When no adapter passes, the operations are off.

adapter.description: The adapter that the running Directus passed, named after the Directus version it was written for.

problems.description: What the running Directus lacks, or has besides, of what each adapter expects, by adapter.

OpenApiDocument.description: An OpenAPI 3.1 document, as the OpenAPI Specification describes it.

client.description: The database client, with the names Directus uses, or unknown when the extension does not recognize it.

version.description: The version as major.minor, or null when the extension cannot read it for this client yet.

level.description: indexed and unindexed run in the database, with or without a spatial index; capped runs in the server of the extension, on a maximum volume; unavailable does not run.

reason.description: Why the operation is unavailable, without naming the database.

Geo.description: The spatial operation of a request, by its id, the canonical term of the glossary in camelCase.

Radius.description: The items within a distance of a point, in meters over the ellipsoid. An item is inside when any part of it is at most at the distance, the edge included.

field.description: The geometry field of the collection the operation reads. It may be left out when the collection has a single geometry field.

Position.description: A point as [longitude, latitude], in WGS 84, as GeoJSON writes it.

Item.description: An item of the collection, with the fields the request asks for, the geometries in GeoJSON and the other values as the database returns them, and the values the operation calculates in $geo.

GeoValues.description: The values the operation calculates for an item, in a reserved field, the way Directus keeps its own in $meta.

distance.description: The distance from the center of the radius to the item, in meters over the ellipsoid: to its nearest part, and zero when the item covers the center.

ItemsMeta.description: What the response tells about the list, the way /items of Directus does in its meta. It only carries what applies to the response.

Capped.description: The list is partial. Where the database in use does not measure the distance, the server of the extension measures it and orders the list by it, over at most limit items of the circle, read in the order of the primary key, and the circle held more. The items past them are missing from the list. A smaller circle, a filter, or a sort of the request, which the database orders, brings the whole list.

limit.description: The most items the server of the extension orders.

Limit.description: How many items a page brings, up to the maximum of the contract.

ErrorCode.description: The codes of the errors of the extension, in the extensions.code of the error format of Directus. Each one starts with GEOSPATIAL_, so it never collides with a code of Directus.

code.description: A code of the extension, or one of Directus, such as FORBIDDEN.
